Our goals in serving the citizens of Wapello County:
To provide accurate and reliable financial records, with full and complete disclosure of the county’s finances.
To preserve integrity and fairness in the election process.
To provide efficient and knowledgeable service to the citizens of Wapello County, and be a key resource for information about Wapello County.
